tests.environment: GRAVURU_PYTHON points to Python with fonttools/svgpathtools/PyMuPDF; TEMP and TMP point to writable test directory
tests.scope: 12 targeted suites; no new entire-repository or Linux run

cache.keys: SVG SHA-256 + requested font versions (file SHA-256 or available glyph-resource SHA-256); font conversion SHA-256 plus converter identity

glyphs.timingScope: Windows renderer call, openKatalog outside timed region, includes requested TTF conversion in cold pass; no HTTP/browser startup included
glyphs.productionLayout: Glyph advances + (n-1)*letterSpacing; no kerning or GSUB/GPOS introduced

browser.scope: Local Chrome with Playwright device profiles; embedded mock Shopify host and synthetic session token. No physical iPhone/Pixel and no live Shopify access.

desktopComparison.scope: Initial viewport; table preview images below viewport. Existing desktop document/body width 1463px remains unchanged.

catalogIntegrity.scope: All locally acquired source inputs verified against pinned catalogue Git blobs, rehashed after tests. Historic designs/bestand and 116 other nonessential artifacts not acquired.

jGeometry.scope: K master preview transformed only for comparison to the saved J physical target matrices; production/font sources and original J PNG hashes verified.
jGeometry.metric: Maximum absolute glyph bounding-box coordinate difference after analytic Bezier bounds; identical glyph paths separately checked

resolved: Font cache detects newly appearing missing font file
Unsupported typography remains complete original text with warning
Preserve rename draft/caret/focus across responsive rendering
